description: Translations of decision notes (choice, alternatives, reason), which content/ keeps in English, keyed by record id and decision id. "source" is a digest of the English each was translated from (owb/notes.py); when the English changes the note is stale and the site shows the English until it is translated again. They state the sense only and use no reader settings. Every note is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it. See docs/notes-translation.md.

alternatives: kile alichonikabidhi (Injili, kama katika mstari wa 14)
m1.reason: παραθήκην μου kihalisi ni "amana yangu". Inaweza kuwa kile ambacho Paulo amemkabidhi Mungu, maisha yake na kazi yake, au Injili ambayo Mungu alimkabidhi Paulo, ambayo ndiyo maana ya "amana" katika mstari wa 14 na 1 Timotheo 6:20. Hapa Mungu ndiye anayeilinda, jambo linalofaa zaidi usomaji wa kwanza.

alternatives: onyo: atabaki mwaminifu kwa neno lake la kuhukumu
m1.reason: Mstari wa nne unavunja mtindo: uaminifu wa Kristo hautegemei uaminifu wetu. Wengi wanausoma kama uhakikisho; wengine kama onyo kwamba anabaki mwaminifu kwa neno lake, pamoja na mstari wa 12. Kwa vyovyote "hawezi kujikana mwenyewe".

m2.choice: wamenaswa naye ili kufanya mapenzi yake: na Ibilisi, kwa ajili ya mapenzi ya Ibilisi
alternatives: wamenaswa na mtumwa wa Bwana, ili kufanya mapenzi ya Mungu
wamenaswa na Ibilisi, na sasa wafanye mapenzi ya Mungu
m2.reason: Viwakilishi viwili tofauti vimetumika, αὐτοῦ ("yeye") na ἐκείνου ("yule"), ambavyo huenda vinarejelea watu tofauti. Kwa kawaida zaidi vyote viwili vinamrejelea Ibilisi, aliyetajwa sasa hivi; lakini ἐκείνου kinaweza kumrejelea Mungu (mstari wa 25), hivi kwamba wanamtoroka Ibilisi ili kufanya mapenzi ya Mungu, au αὐτοῦ kumrejelea mtumwa wa Bwana anayewarudisha.

m1.choice: Kila Andiko limevuviwa na Mungu na linafaa
alternatives: Kila Andiko lililovuviwa na Mungu pia linafaa
m1.reason: Hakuna kitenzi. Wengi wanaongeza "ni" kabla ya θεόπνευστος, hivi kwamba sentensi inasema kwamba Andiko limevuviwa na Mungu na linafaa. Wengine wanalisoma θεόπνευστος kama linaloeleza kiima: kila Andiko lililovuviwa na Mungu pia linafaa. Usomaji wa kwanza unafaa vivumishi vinavyolingana vilivyounganishwa kwa "na".
